entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Misc .
Criminal Case No. 45216 of 2025

Angur @Ankur
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Nilesh Manore - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri K. K. Tiwari - G.A. for State.
ORDER 1] They are heard and perused the case diary.

2] This is the applicant's third bail application filed under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/ Section 439 of Cr.P.C. as he is implicated in connection with Crime No.475/2023 registered at Police Station Thandla, District- Jhabua (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 366, 376(2)(N) & 506 of IPC and Sections 5L/6 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 26.07.2023.

His first application M.Cr.C. No.37873 of 2023 was dismissed by this Court on 30.10.2023 as withdrawn, whereas second application M.Cr.C. No.18363 of 2024 was also dismissed by this Court on 09.05.2024 as withdrawn.
3] The allegation against the applicant is of abduction and rape.

4] Counsel has submitted that subsequently the prosecutrix has also been examined on 21.08.2024, and there are material omissions and NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:29278 2 MCRC-45216-2025 contradictions in her statement and, admittedly, she has resided with the applicant for around 1 month and 11 days, and her age is also disputed.
Thus, it is prayed that the application be allowed.
5] Counsel for the State has opposed the prayer.

6] Having considered the rival submissions, perusal of the case-diary and taking note of the fact that the prosecutrix, who has resided with the applicant Angur @Ankur vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99461284/
1 for more than one month, has also been examined in the trial Court

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: , this Court is inclined to allow the present application, as there is no apprehension that he would temper with the prosecution evidence.
7] Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is hereby allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he / she shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
8] Accordingly, the application is allowed and disposed of.
C.c. as per rules.

(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) JUDGE Pankaj Angur @Ankur vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99461284/
